source.authors: Grassby-Lewis RJ, Brakels P, Maury N, Sitthivong S, Frohlich D, Pawangkhanant P, Idiiatullina SS, Nguyen TV, Poyarkov NA
source.title: A new endemic karst-associated species of lance-headed pit viper (Squamata, Viperidae, Protobothrops) from Laos

method: taxonomic description of the preserved holotype; Methods: measurements with a Mitutoyo digital caliper to the nearest 0.1 mm (ED defined as horizontal eye diameter); no loreal-pit or nostril dimension is measured
conditions: One individual: holotype NUOL R.2024.89 (National University of Laos), adult female, collected 21 October 2024 near Khan Kham Cave, Vang Vieng District, Vientiane Province, Laos. Fixation as printed: 'The specimen was fixed in 4% buffered formalin for 24 h and later stored in 70% ethanol.' Description of the holotype is the only description section (no paratype; the Variation section covers colouration in two iNaturalist photo records and does not mention the loreal pit). The Diagnosis does not mention the loreal pit; the Introduction names a 'well-developed loreal pit' as a genus-level character. Same description prints 'Eyes medium-sized (ED 3.5 mm, EN 5.7 mm; ED/EN ratio 0.61)' and 'Pupil vertically elliptical.' (not filed here). Anatomy only; no function tested.
measurement: loreal pit presence, size, shape and position relative to eye and nostril in the holotype description
value: present, large, triangular, located closer to eye than to nostril
where: Systematics > Protobothrops flavirostris sp. nov. > Description of the holotype
quote: Loreal pit present, large, triangular in shape, located closer to eye than to nostril (Fig. 3C, D).
note: Search that reached the page: 'A new endemic karst-associated species of lance-headed pit viper (Squamata, Viperidae, Protobothrops) from Laos Herpetozoa' (first result, herpetozoa.pensoft.net article_preview.php?id=146004). Name: Reptile Database page Protobothrops flavirostris Grassby-Lewis, Brakels, Maury, Sitthivong, Frohlich, Pawangkhanant, Idiiatullina, Nguyen & Poyarkov, 2025 opened from my own search result (family Viperidae, subfamily Crotalinae; holotype NUOL R.2024.89, adult female; no synonyms; reptile-database.reptarium.cz/Protobothrops/flavirostris). The page prints Family, Subfamily and Genus as bold lines under Systematics, no Class or Order heading. Not on main: grep of docs/ for the species and for herpetozoa.38.e146004 finds only progress notes (desk-d499, d508, d572) that record the species as unreadable or without a printed pupil; no evidence row. Page-printed licence sentence read in three pieces on the exact copy (article_preview): 'This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0), which permits unrestricted use, distribution, and reproduction in any medium, provided the original author and source are credited.' Crossref not used. Sentence read in short reader pieces; the sentence was returned whole in one piece.

source.authors: Chen H-L, Yu J-Y, Li Y-B, Li Y-H, Chen Z-N
source.title: A new species of Goniurosaurus (Sauria, Gekkota, Eublepharidae) from Guangxi, China

measurement: tympanum condition and bordering scales in the holotype description
value: deeply recessed; bordered anteriorly by two spinose scales
method: taxonomic description of the preserved holotype; Methods: morphometric measurements followed Ziegler et al. (2008) with a digital vernier caliper (0.03 mm accuracy); the paper defines no tympanum or ear-opening measurement
conditions: One individual: holotype GXNU2025101603, adult male, Baishou Nature Reserve, Yongfu County, Guilin, Guangxi, China. Preservation as printed: 'All specimens were fixed and preserved in 75% ethanol, and partial muscle tissues were sampled and stored at -80 °C in an ultra-low-temperature freezer for subsequent molecular analyses.' Paratypes are GXNU2025090812, GXNU2025101601 and GXNU2025101602 (females); the Variation section does not mention the tympanum, ear or naris, so no paratype value exists. This is the only sentence on the ear in the Description. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.
where: Systematics > Goniurosaurus wuzhengjuni sp. nov. > Description (holotype paragraph, which opens 'Holotype. GXNU2025101603, adult male')
quote: The tympanum is deeply recessed and bordered anteriorly by two spinose scales.
note: Search that reached the page: 'A New Species of Goniurosaurus (Sauria, Gekkota, Eublepharidae) from Guangxi, China Zoosystematics and Evolution article preview' (result zse.pensoft.net/article_preview.php?id=177343). Name: Reptile Database page Goniurosaurus wuzhengjuni Chen, Yu, Li, Li & Chen, 2026 opened from my own search result (Eublepharidae; holotype GXNU 2025101603; no synonyms; reptile-database.reptarium.cz/Goniurosaurus/wuzhengjuni). The paper's account heading prints the authority as 'Chen & Chen'. Same species and DOI are on main only as one pupil_shape row (desk-d573, 'The eyes are relatively large with vertical pupils.'), a different trait and finding; no sensory_anatomy row. Page-printed licence sentence read in three pieces on the exact copy: 'This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0), which permits unrestricted use, distribution, and reproduction in any medium, provided the original author and source are credited.' Crossref not used. The Description paragraph also prints a naris sentence whose reader rendering was inconsistent, so it is not filed.

source.authors: Poyarkov NA, Skorinova DD, Bragin AM, Kolchanov VV, Gorin VA, Trofimets AV, Yuzefovich AP, Le DX, Nguyen TV, Skutschas PP
source.title: Integrative taxonomy reveals a new unstriped Ichthyophis Fitzinger, 1826 from Vietnam and provides new data on diagnostic osteological traits for Asian tailed caecilians (Gymnophiona: Ichthyophiidae)

method: micro-CT skull atlas of the holotype (SkyScan 1272); osteological description in the Results
conditions: One individual: the holotype ZMMU A-8208 (Zoological Museum of Moscow State University), female, 206 mm total length per the Figure 2 caption ('General skull morphology of the holotype of Ichthyophis griseivermis sp. nov.'), Xuan Lien National Park, Thanh Hoa Province, Vietnam. The skull atlas rests on micro-CT of the cranium and atlas of 'the better-preserved specimen' (Materials and Methods > Micro-computed tomography; SkyScan 1272 microtomograph); the Results state the skull described is that of 'the female specimen ZMMU A-8208'. Preservation as printed in Sampling: 'prior to specimen fixation in a 4% formaldehyde solution for 24 h with subsequent preservation in 70% ethanol.' Skeletal (bony) anatomy from CT, not soft-tissue anatomy. Anatomy only; function not tested.
where: Results > Skull atlas of an Ichthyophis sp. from northern Vietnam > Osteology description > General features of the skull
note: Search that reached the page: 'new species Ichthyophis OR Chikila OR Uraeotyphlus OR Siphonops OR Caecilia sp. nov. 2025 2026 tentacle eyes visible through skin novataxa' (result vertebrate-zoology.arphahub.com/article_preview.php?id=149399). Name: Amphibian Species of the World page Ichthyophis griseivermis Poyarkov, Skorinova, Bragin, Kolchanov, Gorin, Trofimets, Yuzefovich, Le, Nguyen and Skutschas, 2025 opened from my own search result (holotype ZMMU A-8208, no synonymy listed; the page text names no family, the URL path gives Ichthyophiidae and the paper's title prints Ichthyophiidae). Not on main: grep of docs/ for griseivermis and vz.75.e149399 finds only progress notes (desk-d298, d304, d308, d514) recording no eye or ED statement; no evidence row. The reader text for this page covered the first 100000 of 122970 characters plus a read from offset 100000 (table rows only); the species description, diagnosis and variation sections were not returned by the reader, so no description sentence on the tentacular aperture is cited. Page-printed licence sentence read in three pieces on the exact copy: 'This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0), which permits unrestricted use, distribution, and reproduction in any medium, provided the original author and source are credited.' Crossref not used.
measurement: position and openness of the tentacular canal in the holotype skull
value: open laterally, fused with the orbital aperture, lies entirely in the maxillopalatine
quote: The tentacular canal is open laterally, fused with the orbital aperture, and lies entirely in the maxillopalatine.
